interface.request: opcode 6, banks ['B4', 'B8', 'B10'], query_start bits [26:17], m_count [16:11] 1..32, kv_len [10:0] 1..1024, query_start+m_count<=kv_len, upper payload zero
interface.response: held done_valid/done_ready, tag B4, bank_count=3, all three banks released, error flag
interface.layout: Q B4 [m,9,64]; K B8 [kv_len,3,64]; score B10 [m,9,ceil(kv_len/8)]
interface.completion_order: after final destination BF16 strobe handshake and all heads/tiles complete

architecture.algorithm: 16x16 shared GEMM PE array; Q and K 128-bit reads; each of nine query heads runs N tiles of at most 192 keys; K reduction is 64; future and padded scores are zero
architecture.score_mask: future and padded score lanes written zero
architecture.bank_access: one outstanding read per source role; output BF16 element writes use two-byte strobes; fabric demultiplexes command, response and bank roles by logical channel

numeric.input: finite BF16 operands; nonfinite input reports executor error
numeric.multiply: one registered 8x8 BF16 significand multiplier in each of 256 PEs
numeric.accumulator: K ascending, signed 32-bit shared-exponent mantissa with four guard bits; alignment shifts truncate magnitude toward zero
numeric.output: BF16 round-to-nearest-even; QK score exponent reduced by three for /8
numeric.observed_error: XSIM first-layer checkpoint full prefill32 and decode1: score max 1 BF16 ULP, context max 3 BF16 ULP

verification.standalone: shared GEMM mode XSIM full prefill32 and decode1 golden pass; synthetic N=193 and K=193 tile boundary pass
verification.integration: prefill32, focused one-key, and decode1 kv_len=33 two-command-chunk XSIM PASS with first 16 values per row; normal GEMM regression XSIM PASS
verification.physical_board: 100 MHz ZCU104 Vivado 2025.2 routed WNS +1.475 ns, WHS +0.010 ns, WPWS +3.500 ns; BIT/XSA/ELF matching verified; physical board execution pending user
